tools.title: Tools
tools.description: Define what agents can do in {{project}}. Connect credentials and control access here.
tools.importUnavailable: Importing tools from another project is not available yet.
tools.filterUnavailable: Filtering by type is not available yet.
tools.ownership: Tools and secrets belong to {{project}}. Import from another project to create independent local copies.
tools.notFound: This tool is no longer available.
tools.emptyDetail: Create a command tool, then publish it for pipeline steps.
tools.otherKinds: HTTP, MCP, database and pull request tools need project secrets, approvals or GitHub push, which are not available in this version yet.
tools.menuDetail: Choose how the action runs. Configure it next, then publish it for pipeline steps.
tools.stale: Draft saved · Published v{{version}} is newer
tools.newDetail: Runs a program in the worktree of the step that calls it.
tools.enterRequired: Enter a name and a program to save the draft.
tools.fixFields: Fix the marked fields to save the draft.
tools.staleFirst: Keep this draft or start from the latest version first.
tools.versionLimit: The last version number has been reached.
tools.name: Name
tools.nameHint: Set when the tool was created.
tools.programHint: A name on the search path (cargo) or an absolute path outside this project’s repository. The file found is stored as a fixed path.
tools.argumentsHint: Passed to the program as they are. No shell reads them, so quotes, * and $ are not special.
tools.worktree: The worktree of the step that runs it
tools.runHint: Any other exit code, or running past the timeout, fails the step; its failure route decides what follows. When the program prints more than the limit, the latest output is kept.
tools.environmentHint: Added to the cleaned environment every program gets (PATH, HOME, TEMP and the like). Stored and shown in plain text, so never put secrets here.
tools.execution: A command step runs its program with your rights, network access and no sandbox, on files the agents before it wrote. Approve it only after agents you would let run code that way.
tools.inputsDetail: Input schemas, output mapping and secret bindings are not available in this version.
tools.usageDetail: A tool’s usage log is not available yet. Its output is kept in the run’s transcript.
tools.locked: Not available in this version yet.
tools.accessDetail: Every pipeline step that selects this tool can run it. Limiting it to chosen pipelines and steps, an environment, approval for each call or an access window is planned.
tools.usesNote: Only published pipeline versions are listed. Runs keep the tool version they started with.
tools.noUses: No published pipeline calls this tool yet.
tools.commandNote: Command tools hold no secrets: the program runs with the cleaned environment and the variables above, and its output is kept in the run’s transcript.
tools.readOnlyTitle: This tool can’t be edited in this version.
tools.readOnlyDetail: Only command tools can be created and edited today. A command tool runs a program in the worktree of the step that calls it.
tools.staleTitle: A newer version was published after this draft was started
tools.staleDetail: Keep this draft to publish it over the latest version, or start from that version first.
tools.changed: The stored tool changed while you were editing. Reload it before saving.
